name: Greenwin
platform_evidence: Images from assets.rentsync.com/greenwin/. Site script is /scripts/main.js. Search page calls api.theliftsystem.com/v2/search. Suite markup uses classes suite, suite-type, suite-bath, suite-sqft, suite-rate, suite-availability.
data_endpoint: https://api.theliftsystem.com/v2/search (query keys include client_id, auth_token, city_id, limit, offset, order, show_custom_fields). Returned a JSON array of 110 buildings, 41 with city Toronto.
unit_level: unit type. The API is per building. The building page HTML has one row per suite type with baths, sqft, a 'FROM $X/mth' rent (rent_is_floor) and availability.
notes: Search also returned https://www.greenwin.ca/apartments-for-rent/details/88-erskine-ave. Greenwin also has a company page on rentseeker.ca. Browser check: client_id and auth_token are supplied by the site's own script, not by an inline script on the page.
data_fields: Per building: id, name, permalink, address{address, city, postal_code}, geocode{latitude, longitude}, statistics.suites{rates{min,max}, bedrooms{min,max}, square_feet{min,max}}, matched_beds, availability_status, availability_count, min_availability_date.
